_about: Agent Skills index for https://mantaui.com. The Agent Skills format is described at https://agentskills.io — a YAML frontmatter block (name, description, license) followed by Markdown body. Each skill here is a discrete capability a coding agent can pick up at runtime.

skills.name: manta
skills.description: Install Manta UI, a self-hosted Claude Code and opencode client, on a user-owned Linux box or Mac. Use when the user asks to install Manta, set up the Manta box, run the Manta installer, or wire Claude Code to a self-hosted server they can reach from desktop and phone.
